Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The expert evaluated whether members had ever held C‑suite roles, not whether they held such roles at the time they joined Apple’s board. In step 10 it incorrectly asserted Wanda Austin held a C‑suite position when she joined (she had left The Aerospace Corporation in 2016 and joined Apple’s board in 2018). This misinterpretation propagated to others (e.g., Ronald D. Sugar, Susan L. Wagner) and led to the wrong final conclusion.
